At some point, a '''species''' of gigantic [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] lived on [[Shoon]], a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]] region. The [[Species/Legends|species]] built structures across their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] surface.<ref name="TEA" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="date">The main section of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which includes a description of [[Shoon]], ends with a mention of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]]'s journey across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the beginning of which is depicted in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''. The events of that novel are dated to [[43 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> the humanoids had gone extinct, with the ruins of their structures left as the only testament to their former existence. Like the other worlds of the Senex-Juvex, Shoon eventually came under the control of the region's [[Noble/Legends|aristocratic]] [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] [[Ancient Houses]], which had [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] the Senex-Juvex between [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[700 BBY]] and had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the native [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
